title.en: EchoSparse: Letting Last Step's Statistics Steer This Step, and Packing Sparse Attention Tightly
title.zh: EchoSparse：让上一步的统计量为下一步指路，再把稀疏 attention 排得更紧

dek.en: EchoSparse reuses LSE and block-mass statistics across denoising steps, combines exact and representative terms in one weighted softmax, and organizes packed work for TMA and GPU pipelining.
dek.zh: EchoSparse 在去噪步之间复用 LSE 与块质量统计量，让精算 token 和代表项共用一个加权 softmax，再通过 packed 布局、TMA 与 GPU 流水线组织计算。

teaser_alt.en: EchoSparse on Wan2.1-14B: 1.70× faster than FlashAttention-4 on a B200, closer to the dense video than Sol-Attn and PISA
teaser_alt.zh: EchoSparse 在 Wan2.1-14B 上：B200 上比 FlashAttention-4 快 1.70 倍，比 Sol-Attn 和 PISA 更接近稠密结果
